text:
ashley: Quick sync — rolling out cert provisioning for asia-east-1 and eu-west-2 tomorrow. Couple questions re: RBAC for the cert issuer and KMS usage.

mike: Are we using customer KMS or Redwood-managed keys for these regions?

ashley: Customer-managed for Private customers; Redwood-managed for hosted. Need to ensure cert-manager service account has kms:Decrypt in the region where the key lives.

sanjay: For RBAC I propose a scoped role 'cert-issuer' with only these perms:

```yaml
rules:
- apiGroups: ['']
  resources: ['secrets']
  verbs: ['get','create','patch','update']
  resourceNames: ['redwood-tls-*']
```

Place the rolebinding in namespace 'redwood-system' only.

eva: Audit logging: enable CloudTrail for kms:Encrypt/Decrypt and iam:Sign. Also ensure cert-manager events are forwarded to our audit-logs ELK with tag `certs`.

cert-manager-bot: Issued cert prod/api.eu-west-2.redwood.company, expires 2026-09-10T04:12:00Z

ashley: Good. One more: cross-region cert lookup — won't the cert-manager need IAM 'kms:Decrypt' in origin region? If so, we need either cross-account grants or replicate keys.

mike: Cross-region KMS decrypt isn't allowed. We must either replicate secrets/keys or have cert issuance per-region. Replicating keys needs multi-region keys or custom replication.

sanjay: Operationally safer to issue per-region certs and keep keys regional. Simpler RBAC.

deploy-bot: Started: role/cert-issuer apply to cluster: prod-eu-west-2 (job 3821)

mike: Vulnerability note: some infra nodes still on OpenSSL 3.0.8 which has CVE-XXXX. Recommend pinning back to 3.0.7 or applying distro patch; schedule non-disruptive rolling upgrade.

eva: Triage: severity medium for now. Add to vuln-triage board, tag owners, set 48h SLA.

ashley: Incident plan update: if cert issuance fails, fallback is to serve a wildcard cert from S3 (encrypted with KMS key) while we remediate. Add runbook step to rotate to fallback and notify customers if using customer-managed KMS.

sanjay: Also add a healthcheck that checks cert expiry < 14 days and triggers PagerDuty with runbook link.

mike: I'll review the RBAC PR after standup. Can we canary deploy to us-west-2 first?

ashley: yes — canary in us-west-2, then roll to eu and asia if green. I'll open PR and include the KMS policy docs.

eva: I'll update the audit dashboards and set an alert for any anomalous kms:Decrypt rates.

mike: :thumbsup: 

ashley: thanks all — will post PR link here when ready.
